name: Koeda Fumi
source:
Formed Sub-Couple 01 with [url=/c128231]Doujima Taiga[/url].

[url=/c125790]Kokoro[/url]'s best friend. Loves to prank and tease on maidens in love and the boys.
Doesn't care much about her own love life and is easy going with boys.
While watching over her bestfriends, she wishes something interesting would happen.
Intended to toy with Taiga, which she finds amusing, but keeps getting unexpected counterattacks and ends up being the one who gets messed with instead.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.asa-pro.com/koibana/character/subcouples.html]official website[/url]]
